settings.heading: Where we ship
settings.content: We currently ship only within the United States. International shipping is not available at launch.

settings.heading: Free US shipping
settings.content: Shipping is free on all orders within the United States, with no minimum order. Applicable taxes are calculated at checkout.

settings.heading: Processing and delivery
settings.content:
Orders are normally processed within 1–2 business days. Typical delivery is 3–7 business days after shipment. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date.

Orders may be shipped via USPS, FedEx, or another carrier used by our fulfillment partner. Some orders may arrive in more than one shipment.

settings.heading: Tracking your order
settings.content: You should receive tracking information when available after your order ships.

settings.heading: Changing your shipping address
settings.content: If you need to change your shipping address, contact us as soon as possible at support@getsendler.com. We’ll do our best to help, but changes cannot be guaranteed once an order has entered fulfillment.

settings.heading: Delivered but missing
settings.content: If tracking shows your order as delivered but you can’t find it, contact support@getsendler.com and we’ll help you investigate the shipment with the carrier.

settings.heading: Problems with your order
settings.content: If your order arrives damaged, defective, incorrect, or missing an item due to a fulfillment error, contact support@getsendler.com. We’ll arrange an appropriate replacement or refund and cover the related return or replacement costs.
